all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Use for ordinary formation under Burundi's Law 1/09 of 30 May 2011, the national Code des sociétés privées et à participation publique. The relevant private form is SPRL, Société de Personnes à Responsabilité Limitée; the sole-member form is SU, Société Unipersonnelle. SA is the Société Anonyme. Use the statutory forms rather than the old SARL/OHADA description. Natural or legal persons can be founders subject to legal capacity/incompatibility and form-specific conditions. [Company code arts. 1–4, 30, 162, 225 and 270–273](https://www.obr.bi/images/stories/download/CODE_DES_SOCIETES_PRIVEES_ET_A_PARTICIPATION_PUBLIQUE_Verrs_Fin1.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: A foreign branch is registered but has no separate legal personality; a Burundi subsidiary is its own company. Identify which vehicle is being registered before using the same application documents. [Arts. 13–14](https://www.obr.bi/images/stories/download/CODE_DES_SOCIETES_PRIVEES_ET_A_PARTICIPATION_PUBLIQUE_Verrs_Fin1.pdf); [ADB published procedure](https://investburundi.bi/procedure-de-la-creation/).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## The base
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-company-formation.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: The articles must state legal form, object, name, geographic seat, duration, capital, contributions/share values, profit allocation and organs. A post-office box alone is not the statutory geographic seat. Capital in cash requires the bank's deposit certificate; in-kind contributions require valuation under the applicable code provisions, not a fictitious cash deposit. Signature, filing, publication and registration create the legal-personality sequence. [Arts. 7, 11, 17–23 and 33–36](https://www.obr.bi/images/stories/download/CODE_DES_SOCIETES_PRIVEES_ET_A_PARTICIPATION_PUBLIQUE_Verrs_Fin1.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-company-formation.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: For an SPRL appoint the management required by art. 236: one or more natural or legal-person managers, whether members or outsiders, named in the articles or later act. The old statement “one shareholder for a SARL” confuses this with an SU. An SPRL reduced to one member must regularise or become an SU within one year; one exceeding fifty must regularise or become an SA within one year. [Arts. 225–229, 236 and 278](https://www.obr.bi/images/stories/download/CODE_DES_SOCIETES_PRIVEES_ET_A_PARTICIPATION_PUBLIQUE_Verrs_Fin1.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-company-formation.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: An SU must have a natural-person manager under art. 278, unlike the wider SPRL manager rule. The code permits natural and legal sole members under art. 272, except that an SU cannot create another SU. There is no basis here for the old generic rule that every corporate founder must bring a second shareholder. Check a regulated business's separate licensing/capital conditions; the ordinary freely set capital rule does not establish a universal dollar minimum.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Deadlines and filing
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-company-formation.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. Confirm vehicle, founders/representatives, legal capacity, actual address, object, proposed name, capital and manager. For a legal-person founder obtain its NIF, RC, articles and notarised resolution of intention. For a foreign subsidiary or branch ADB requests the notarised decision authorising operations and appointing the Burundi representative, together with parent statutes, RC and NIF. [ADB document lists](https://investburundi.bi/procedure-de-la-creation/).
2. Prepare/sign the articles, capital-payment bank evidence and applicable in-kind valuation. Check the name in the registration process before filing; this Guide does not establish a separate compulsory reservation fee or promise availability. [Arts. 7, 19, 33–36](https://www.obr.bi/images/stories/download/CODE_DES_SOCIETES_PRIVEES_ET_A_PARTICIPATION_PUBLIQUE_Verrs_Fin1.pdf).
3. The ADB procedure sends applicants to [easybusiness.bi](https://easybusiness.bi). Select “s’enregistrer”, enter identification/email, create account credentials and confirm through the email link. Prepare the identity card/passport and, where relevant, residence card; use the person-morale path for a company and person-physique path for an individual business. Upload the relevant founder/formation documents and retain the fee payment evidence. These are the public instructions; authenticated company-form fields and final submission receipt have not been accessed. [Public procedure](https://investburundi.bi/procedure-de-la-creation/).
4. Reconcile commercial registration and tax registration separately. The budgets reserve RC registration to ADB (ANACOOP for cooperatives) and NIF attribution exclusively to OBR. July art. 233 expressly preserves the current registration procedure until effective deployment of the integrated tax-registration module. Do not promise that the online RC screen itself issues a legally sufficient NIF. Obtain both outputs and check names/address/entity form; follow up on a missing NIF within the statutory registration period. [Art. 213](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 233](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
5. Keep RC, NIF, signed articles, founder decisions, bank/valuation documents and official receipts. Set up accounts and tax/payroll registrations applicable to the actual activity, then use [corporate income tax](bi-corporate-income-tax.md), [VAT](bi-vat-gst.md) and [payroll/INSS](bi-payroll-social.md) for their different return calendars. The company code's accounts and meeting rules still apply; tax filing does not replace company governance. [Arts. 69 and 242–252](https://www.obr.bi/images/stories/download/CODE_DES_SOCIETES_PRIVEES_ET_A_PARTICIPATION_PUBLIQUE_Verrs_Fin1.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-corporate-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Use this for ordinary taxable companies under income law arts. 94–104 and nonresident permanent establishments under arts. 101 and 108–109. Incorporation under Burundi law or effective management in Burundi makes an entity resident. A resident company includes worldwide business income; a nonresident PE accounts for the profits attributable to it. Rental income is a separate calculation routed to [individual and rental income](bi-income-tax.md), rather than automatically subjected to the ordinary corporate rate. [IR arts. 4, 94–104](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Calendar 2026 crosses two budget laws. [2025/26 modified budget art. 252](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf) starts on 1 January; [2026/27 budget art. 277](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf) starts on 1 July. Do not extend a fiscal-year-specific concession beyond its stated period or assume the budget year replaces a company's approved accounting year.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## The base
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-corporate-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Start with accounting receipts and expenses, then identify exempt income and add back nonbusiness or unsupported costs. Deduction requires an effective business expense, evidence, a reduction in net assets and attribution to the fiscal year. Dividends/profit appropriations, fines, personal expenditure, income tax, recoverable VAT and revaluation depreciation do not become ordinary business deductions. A commercial asset disposal is included in corporate business income; the separate individual gains rate is not a corporate disposal rate. [IR arts. 37, 54–55 and 98](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-corporate-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Apply the additional invoice-transmission condition in both 2026 periods: the modified budget art. 243 applies from 1 January through 30 June, and July budget art. 268 from 1 July. For an invoice not sent to OBR’s EBMS database when issued, the related expense is not tax-deductible. Persons required to keep simplified or complete accounts must use an approved electronic invoicing machine. Retain evidence of transmission at issue and add back costs failing the condition; meeting the principal-law business-purpose test alone is insufficient. This is an income-tax deduction condition, separate from VAT recovery. [Modified budget art. 243](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July budget art. 268](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-corporate-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Keep a fixed-asset register. Land is not depreciable; buildings use 5% straight line, heavy industrial equipment, aircraft and ships 10% straight line, intangibles 10% straight line, IT 50% declining pool and other depreciable assets 25% declining pool. A pool base not exceeding BIF 500,000 is deducted in full; disposal proceeds reduce the pool and a negative pool is recaptured. Check acquisition/use dates and special rules before computing a year's allowance. [IR arts. 59–68](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Deadlines and filing
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-corporate-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. Close the calendar year, unless the Commissioner General has approved a different twelve-month year. Separately file the detailed and valued stock inventory within thirty days after accounting year-end under procedure art. 29; do not wait for the annual income-return deadline. Prepare the signed accounts, fiscal bridge, depreciation schedule and notes accompanying that annual return under the same article, and keep art. 30 documents ready for a tax-authority request. Medium and large returns require certification by an accountant registered with the professional order. File the annual business return by the end of the third month after year-end; calendar 2026 therefore ends at 31 March 2027, subject to a later enacted extension. [IR arts. 16–18 and 104](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf); [arts. 29–30](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_RELATIVE_AUX_PROCEDURES_FISCALES_ET_NON_FISCALES_2020.pdf).
2. In [Déclaration des revenus des sociétés](https://www.obr.bi/images/IR_SOCIETE_2021_VF_CORRIGE_octobre_2021_1.pdf), enter NIF, entity, address and actual fiscal period. Lines 1–8 reconcile receipts; 9–10 expenses/accounting result; 11 addbacks from annex 1; 12 deductions/losses from annex 2; 13 taxable profit/loss. Compare line 14 minimum with line 15 ordinary tax. Use lines 18–22 only for evidenced eligible withholding, advances and foreign credit. Line 23 is the balance. Attach required accounts and detailed schedules. Do not use an old incentive line merely because it is printed.
3. Pay the three provisional amounts by 30 June, 30 September and 31 December of the activity year for a calendar-year company. The first period covers the first half-year and the next two the corresponding quarters; approved alternative years use the sixth, ninth and twelfth month ends. First partial prior years require annualisation. Reconcile all payments on the annual return. [IR arts. 130–133](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
4. Use OBR's [published Umutangakori routing](https://www.obr.bi/index.php/teledeclaration-telepaiement) for your taxpayer category. Obtain the confidential Extranet number, administrator authority and identity document; complete the adhesion and activation described in the [login manual](https://www.obr.bi/images/Guide-utilisateur-adhesion-et-connexion.pdf). The published return includes payment mode, quittance number/date and acknowledgment fields. Keep the filed return, stamped/electronic acknowledgment and bank/quittance evidence separately. The current authenticated submission and payment-reference screens are not established by this Guide.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-corporate-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Assume an ordinary resident trading company, no exemptions or incentives, BIF 120,000,000 turnover, BIF 20,000,000 accounting profit and a BIF 1,000,000 nondeductible fine. Taxable profit is BIF 21,000,000. Ordinary tax BIF 6,300,000 exceeds the BIF 1,200,000 minimum.
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-corporate-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

```oa-check
name: Ordinary corporate profit
inputs:
  turnover: 120000000
  accounting_profit: 20000000
  fine: 1000000
steps:
  - taxable: accounting_profit + fine
  - ordinary: taxable * 0.30
  - minimum: turnover * 0.01
  - tax: max(ordinary,minimum)
expected:
  tax: 6300000
```

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Assume an ordinary company with BIF 300,000,000 turnover, BIF 6,000,000 taxable profit and BIF 4,000,000 prior assessed tax, without eligible period withholding. Compare BIF 1,800,000 ordinary tax with BIF 3,000,000 minimum: the minimum governs. Three BIF 1,000,000 advances total BIF 3,000,000, leaving no annual balance. A loss would not remove this minimum.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Use for a Burundi payer, a resident with foreign income or a nonresident with Burundi activity. An individual is resident if there is a permanent residence in Burundi or presence exceeds 183 days in a twelve-month period ending in the fiscal year; diplomatic/public-service residence cases require the remaining art. 3 condition, which is not fully legible in the captured scan and is excluded here. An entity is resident if constituted under Burundi law or effectively managed here at any time in the fiscal year. Residents include foreign-source income; nonresidents include Burundi-source income. [IR arts. 3–7, 20 and 100–102](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## The base
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-cross-border-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Apply the PE analysis before using final nonresident service withholding. A fixed business installation with permanence can be a PE; construction and service periods above are additional tests. Check the narrowly specified storage/display and preparatory/auxiliary exclusions, habitual contracting or stock-delivery dependent agents, independent agents acting in their ordinary business and the special insurance rule. Ownership/control alone does not create a PE. A PE requires separate books and profit attribution; the [corporate Guide](bi-corporate-income-tax.md) owns that computation. [IR arts. 8–13 and 108–109](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-cross-border-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: For withholding, identify payer, recipient, payment category, gross payment and PE attribution. Both 2026 budgets replace art. 122 with the categories above; their identical core rates do not authorise withholding on every foreign payment. PE payers also apply the withholding rules. Keep a category schedule and certificates. A buyer's nonresident-asset withholding is not a substitute for the seller's gain-base computation. [Art. 148](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 156](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf); [IR arts. 123–129](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-cross-border-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: For foreign credit, prove country/tax-authority address, income-tax amount, reason, year and date/mode of payment using an assessment, withholding certificate or similar acceptable evidence, certified by the issuing foreign tax authority. Attach it to the return, or supply the proof within six months after Burundi tax becomes due; otherwise the deducted credit must be repaid with applicable interest/penalties. If not in Kirundi, English or French, provide a certified translation into one of those languages. This is a credit ceiling, not a guaranteed refund of all foreign tax. [IR arts. 14–15](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-cross-border-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Keep VAT on imported services separate from income withholding; use [VAT](bi-vat-gst.md) even if the recipient is not VAT-registered. Use [transfer pricing](bi-transfer-pricing.md) for group charges and financing, rather than treating withholding payment as proof of expense deductibility.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Deadlines and filing
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-cross-border-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. Obtain contracts/invoices, actual service location and personnel-day/project records, residence/entity facts, recipient identity and PE attribution. Document any asserted treaty before reducing a domestic amount.
2. In [monthly return section IV](https://www.obr.bi/images/DECLARATION_TVA-_IRE-_PF_ET_AUTRES_RETENUES_A_LA_SOURCE-2021-VF-juillet-2022-vf-1.pdf), map dividends, interest, royalties, nonresident services, specified group/technical fees and vehicle hire to lines 1–6. Enter payment date, taxable payment, rate and tax in columns 2–5. Nonresident asset acquisition belongs to line 9. The historic form's other sector lines do not establish current liability. July art. 156 separately sets 10% gaming charges on deposits, withdrawals, gross profit of gaming companies and promotional prizes; those charges are outside this Guide. Reconcile section IV total line 15 to the payment.
3. File the prescribed withholding return and remit within fifteen calendar days after the payment month. Retain payment-category and tax registers for the ten fiscal years following the withholding year; provide the recipient its evidence as required. The withholding agent is personally liable for a failure, and cannot shift its own penalties/interest to the recipient. [IR arts. 124–129](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).

Current authenticated completion screens are not established here. Claim a resident foreign credit through the annual income return's foreign-tax line with the certified evidence, respecting the domestic cap; use the [corporate](bi-corporate-income-tax.md) or [individual](bi-income-tax.md) filing route.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## The base
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Business income is receipts less allowable business costs and fiscal adjustments. Separately identify asset-disposal proceeds: art. 23 expressly subjects the product of art. 37(2) asset sales to the individual second-category rate; do not tax that disposal automatically as ordinary business profit or equate it to the corporate rule. The [corporate Guide](bi-corporate-income-tax.md) explains the shared expense, depreciation and loss provisions, including the additional EBMS invoice-transmission condition under modified budget art. 243 and July budget art. 268, with the individual regime switch above applied first. For the annual business method, an expense related to an invoice not sent to EBMS when issued is not deductible; the principal-law expense test alone does not establish deductibility. [Modified budget art. 243](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July budget art. 268](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf). Do not use employment bands on ordinary self-employment profit. [IR arts. 21, 37, 54–80](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Agriculture, livestock and fish farming income is exempt under arts. 47–48. Actual fishing has its own gross-receipts limit of BIF 20,000,000 per fiscal year. The taxpayer must retain evidence. Activities that transform the product, even artisanally, fall outside this agricultural exemption; the old alleged BIF 1,800,000 agricultural ceiling is not the rule. [IR arts. 47–48](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: For ordinary building rent, start from gross receipts, deduct the statutory 40% repairs/maintenance allowance and actually paid interest on a loan financing acquisition, construction or renewal; for subletting apply the distinct art. 87(2) deduction of rent paid, rather than automatically adding the ordinary letting allowance. The BIF 4,800,000 abatement in art. 84 belongs only to the listed vulnerable persons, not every landlord. Newly constructed buildings receive a two-year first-letting exemption under the budget, excluding subletting. Obtain proof of the first letting and construction before claiming it. [IR arts. 81–87](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf); [Art. 208](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 227](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: The budgets move market-operation and land-rental receipts out of business income into rental income; furnished hotels, motels, accommodation establishments and function halls stay business income. The January text expressly describes the rental building base; July art. 80 expressly adds rented land. Do not resolve a first-half land-rent base dispute by silently applying the later wording. From July keep a copy of the lease at the rented premises and use bank/electronic payment for rents in designated A/B neighborhoods. [Arts. 80–81](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Arts. 79–80](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Individual disposal gains require their own asset, acquisition date, sale value, exemptions and statutory valuation under arts. 88–93. Do not apply the headline rate to gross property proceeds or treat the nonresident buyer withholding as the final gain calculation. Detailed property valuation orders and relief claims remain outside this computation.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Deadlines and filing
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-income-tax.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. Obtain NIF, identity, fiscal-year dates, sales/purchase books, allowable costs and withholding/payment certificates. The annual business return is due at the end of the third month following the year; employment collected entirely at source has the annual-filing exemptions in art. 25, not an unconditional exemption for every employee with other income. Rental declarations have a separate 31 March following-receipt-year deadline under both budgets. [IR arts. 24–26](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf); [Art. 79](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 78](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
2. For ordinary annual business income use [Déclaration des revenus des personnes physiques](https://www.obr.bi/images/FORMULAIRE_IR_PERSONNE_PHYSIQUE_2021_VF_Corrig%C3%A9_octobre_2021.pdf): identity/period, lines 1–11 products, 12–22 expenses, 23 accounting result, 24–27 fiscal bridge, 28 minimum/29 ordinary tax, and evidenced credits at 32–36. Line 37 is the balance. Sign and attach required accounts/bridge; old printed investment concessions are not automatic entitlements. If subject to procedure art. 29, separately file the detailed and valued stock inventory within thirty days after accounting year-end, before the third-month annual-return deadline. [Procedure art. 29, PDF p. 11](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_RELATIVE_AUX_PROCEDURES_FISCALES_ET_NON_FISCALES_2020.pdf).
3. For the quarterly regime use [Déclaration trimestrielle](https://www.obr.bi/images/20232024_DECLARATION_TRIMESTRIELLE_IMPOT_SUR_LE_REVENU_DES_PERSONNES_PHYSIQUES_copy.pdf): enter the quarter/identity, turnover column 1, rate column 2, tax column 3, evidenced withholding credits and the balance. Income art. 24 provides quarterly frequency, but the captured clause does not state a quarterly due day. OBR’s undated FAQ lists payment dates for the first three quarters, yet contains other superseded details and no fourth-quarter date; the complete current quarterly filing/payment deadline remains unconfirmed here. If annual turnover crosses the budget threshold, switch to the annual return and required books; keep the quarterly payments for reconciliation rather than taxing the same receipts twice. [Art. 24](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf); [Art. 190](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
4. A rental advance is due by 30 September and must equal at least a quarter of the prior assessed rental tax. The source does not provide a four-date rental advance calendar; do not invent one. [Art. 82](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 81](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
5. Follow the category-specific links on OBR's [portal page](https://www.obr.bi/index.php/teledeclaration-telepaiement). Keep the signed return, submission acknowledgment and quittance/bank payment proof, matching NIF, period and tax. Published business forms include receipt fields; current rental-form boxes and authenticated submission screens are unresolved.

```oa-check
  - annual_minimum: over_limit * 0.01
  - annual_tax: max(annual_ordinary,annual_minimum)
  - difference: annual_tax - quarterly_regime_year_tax
expected:
  quarterly_regime_year_tax: 250000
  annual_tax: 780000
  difference: 530000
```

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Who this applies to
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Use for an employer paying taxable employment remuneration and an ordinary civilian worker within the INSS regime. Identify principal versus secondary employment, casual work and genuine qualifying termination compensation before calculating. The ordinary contribution example does not cover police, military or other difficult-work rates, voluntary insurance or public-service schemes. [IR arts. 30–34 and 112–119](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf); [INSS calculation guidance](https://inss.gov.bi/calcul-des-cotisations/).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: The actual [Law 1/05 of 30 April 2026](https://primature.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2026/05/loi_modification_code_protection_sociale.pdf) amends public-sector pension benefit calculations and prior pensions, with implementing orders/decrees; it is not a basis for replacing the ordinary private-sector contribution rates displayed by INSS. Pension benefits and the public-sector implementation are outside this payroll job.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## The base
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: For income withholding, total cash pay and taxable benefits, remove the art. 32 exclusions, and apply only art. 33 permitted deductions. Retained and actually paid employee pension/health contributions are deductible; a hypothetical contribution is not. Transport allowance deduction is capped at 15% of basic salary unless transport is provided in kind; rent allowance deduction is capped at 60% of basic salary. The separate qualifying complementary pension deduction has its 20% gross-employment limit. Do not apply those percentages to every item of gross pay. [IR arts. 30–34](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf); [Art. 147](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 155](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: INSS uses remuneration and benefits in cash, with its own exclusions, including family allowances and reimbursement of expenses; its base is not automatically taxable pay after income-tax allowances. Compute each month’s pension and risk bases with their own caps, then the employee and employer shares separately. INSS also requires the base not to be below the applicable legal minimum salary; no current minimum-wage number is supplied here. [INSS base and worked schedule](https://inss.gov.bi/calcul-des-cotisations/).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: For casual employees income law art. 119 provides a special rate and protected lower band, with practical terms delegated to an order. Do not force a casual employee through the permanent-worker example without the implementing classification. Payroll annualisation and any employee’s other income must be reconciled under the income law, not by adding arbitrary allowances.
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Deadlines and filing
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. Keep employee identity/NIF where issued, contract, principal-employer status, dates, basic salary, allowances, actual contributions and INSS affiliation number. Produce a payslip showing gross components and tax withheld. Remit and declare employment withholding to OBR within the first fifteen days of the following month. Keep an individual annual recap and submit it within thirty days after year-end, with regularisation required by art. 115. A tax-exempt employer does not necessarily exempt its employees: art. 116 requires monthly self-declaration in that situation. [IR arts. 112–116](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
2. Use [monthly joint return section III](https://www.obr.bi/images/DECLARATION_TVA-_IRE-_PF_ET_AUTRES_RETENUES_A_LA_SOURCE-2021-VF-juillet-2022-vf-1.pdf): principal permanent employees on lines 1–4, casual employees on 5–7, secondary employees line 8, early-retirement/complementary-pension rows on lines 9–11, qualifying termination compensation lines 12–15, total line 16. Lines 9–11 are the historical form’s pension block, not a political/public-office category and not independent authority for current pension treatment. Record counts, taxable bases, statutory rates and tax in the displayed columns. IR art. 117 applies the principal progressive scale to political/public-office holders and end-of-mandate compensation beneficiaries; do not route them to pension lines 9–11. Confirm the current category-specific form placement with OBR before submission. [IR art. 117, PDF p. 39](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf). The old printed form is a field map, not authority to override the current law.
3. Use the category-specific OBR [portal link](https://www.obr.bi/index.php/teledeclaration-telepaiement), retaining return acknowledgment and separate quittance/bank payment proof. The exact current taxpayer submission/payment-reference screens and current annual recap download have not been verified.
4. INSS is quarterly for employers: complete the Déclaration des rémunérations et cotisations, Modèle VI, from the monthly capped employee calculations and payroll detail. Declaration and contribution payment are due within the first fifteen days of the month following the calendar quarter. The INSS Q3 2026 notice asks that payment identify employer, affiliation number and quarter, with the payment reference attached to the declaration. Keep the submitted schedule and bank/payment evidence. Voluntary members have a different monthly frequency. [INSS declaration/payment instructions](https://inss.gov.bi/declaration-et-versement-des-cotisations/); [Q3 2026 employer notice](https://inss.gov.bi/declaration-et-paiement-des-cotisations-du-3eme-trimestre-2026-a-linstitut-national-de-securite-sociale/).
5. For foreign employees separately assess the budgets' annual employer charge and keep contract visa, annual gross salary and payment evidence. Do not deduct this employer charge from an employee as an INSS contribution. [Art. 103](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: The budget's replacement employment definition requires notifying OBR of the absence of employment-tax payers three months before contract termination or activity cessation. Record the notice and seek OBR direction where that advance condition cannot be met; do not substitute the old post-cessation month. [Art. 147](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 155](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Cross-border points
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Nonresident employment income is not automatically subject to the passive-income withholding rate. Residence/source and treaty questions go to [cross-border tax](bi-cross-border-tax.md). Employers of foreign labor must check both the ordinary payroll obligations and the separate annual budget charge above; no treaty/social-security exemption is presumed. all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Two worked examples that recompute
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Assume an ordinary principal employee has BIF 500,000 cash gross pay, no allowances/exempt items and no health contribution. Pension employee BIF 18,000; employer pension BIF 27,000; employer risk BIF 2,400. With employee pension actually withheld and paid, taxable pay BIF 482,000, income tax BIF 84,600, cash net BIF 397,400 and employer cost BIF 529,400. This excludes any foreign-labor charge or unverified levy.
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-payroll-social.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
```oa-check
name: Ordinary monthly payroll with distinct caps
inputs:
  gross: 500000
steps:
  - employee_pension: min(gross,450000) * 0.04
  - employer_pension: min(gross,450000) * 0.06
  - risk: min(gross,80000) * 0.03
  - taxable: gross - employee_pension
  - income_tax: min(max(taxable-150000,0),150000)*0.20 + max(taxable-300000,0)*0.30
  - net: gross-employee_pension-income_tax
  - employer_cost: gross+employer_pension+risk
expected:
  employee_pension: 18000
  employer_pension: 27000
  risk: 2400
  income_tax: 84600
  net: 397400
  employer_cost: 529400
```

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Assume BIF 200,000 monthly taxable pay after valid deductions. A principal employer computes BIF 10,000 under the bands; a secondary employer must withhold BIF 60,000. The BIF 50,000 difference is determined by the employee’s actual principal-employer status, not an option to select the lower result.

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## The base
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-property-transactions.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. **Separate charges.** Keep a distinct line for the purchaser’s wealth tax, mortgage charge, electronic-title charge, construction tax and unresolved transfer duty/other fees. The mortgage base is the **total debt/credit**, not only the amount entered as security or the property sale price. A secured-title fee cap does not cap another tax. [January arts. 138–142](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July arts. 146–150](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
2. **Registration valuation.** Under the principal law, transfer duty is computed on the price or value determined under art. 5. An exchange uses the agreed value of the side that would give the higher duty if priced in money. A missing, insufficiently determined or below-market price requires a certified, signed value declaration at the foot of the deed; if a party cannot write, the registrar records it before two signing witnesses. The base cannot be less than market value, and contract prices are stated in BIF. The registrar can substitute an assessment or expertise; the competent local court can order expertise at the parties’ request. [Registration arts. 4–7, 19–20](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
3. **Split rights are not a full-ownership shortcut.** For creation/transfer of usufruct, including a limited term, the price base cannot fall below 75% of full-ownership market value; without a determined price use full-ownership market value. For bare ownership with usufruct retained by the transferor, the floor is full-ownership market value; otherwise the law deducts the usufruct value estimated under art. 6. A later transfer of usufruct to the bare owner is exempt from proportional duty and subject to fixed duties only where proportional duty was already paid on full value by that bare owner or a predecessor from whom the right derives. [Registration arts. 8–10](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
4. **Emphyteusis.** Creation uses the cumulative dues over the right’s duration; transfer uses dues for the remaining duration. Transfer of the underlying property, wholly or partly subject to emphyteusis, uses full-ownership market value. [Registration arts. 11–13](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
5. **Exemptions require the right party and tax.** State and administrative public establishments are exempt from fixed, proportional and progressive registration duties only for transfers in their favour. Communes have the stated exemption from proportional duties only for transfers in their favour. Art. 15 exempts proportional duty for the specified gratuitous transfers to a religious denomination or scientific/philanthropic association with legal personality, or from such a body to another institution/association of the same nature. These principal registration exemptions do not by themselves exempt every property tax. A separate 2026 budget overlay exempts **gifts granted to the State and its administrative subdivisions from all taxes, duties and charges**: January art. 207 applies in the first period and July art. 226 in the second. Confirm both the gift and qualifying beneficiary; this does not make an ordinary purchase exempt from all taxes or extend that gift rule to every religious/scientific/philanthropic body. Do not equate an administrative public establishment with an administrative subdivision without confirming its legal status. [Registration arts. 14–15](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf); [January art. 207](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July art. 226](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
6. **No invented transfer tariff.** Both budgets require the finance, justice and infrastructure ministers to update property-transfer rates by order. The actual 2020 annex was read, but the operative updated tariff/order has not been reconciled. Do not turn its historic sale, gift, succession or restructuring rows into a final 2026 conveyancing quote. State pre-emption is available where the sale price of built or unbuilt property is understated. [January arts. 103–104](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July arts. 108–109](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).

July budget arts. 95, 246 and 247 address undefined building use, specified gifts and mixed-use buildings; January arts. 94, 226 and 227 must be checked for a first-half event. Route the actual supply and deduction computation to [VAT](bi-vat-gst.md), and obtain the property-specific implementing text before computing an unresolved mixed-use allocation. A gift is not exempt from all taxes merely because it is between relatives. all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Deadlines and filing
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-property-transactions.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. **Before signing:** obtain identity/NIF, transaction type/date, property identification, title or communal certificate, title extract, area/category evidence, price/valuations, acquisition sequence and finance documents. The principal law requires anyone asked to sign a transaction/deed concerning titled property, including a notary/public officer, to obtain a land-register extract beforehand; its validity is **60 calendar days**. If the property’s physical substance has changed, update the sketch, survey/boundary record and title before transfer, mortgage or other real-right constitution. [Registration arts. 23, 25](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
2. **Authentic deed and tax schedule:** the budget requires authentic notarial form and deposit among the notary’s minutes for the described real-right transactions and urban property leases. For urban transactions within this wording, do not treat an informal signed contract as sufficient. A constitutive/transfer deed of real property rights lists all applicable fees/taxes, payable **no later than 30 days after signature of the authentic deed**. Keep this payment clock separate from the registration-notification clock. The prescribed contract format/mandatory-mentions order remains unresolved. [January art. 141](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July art. 149](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
**Separate weekly notary/public-officer reporting:** at the end of each week, without undue delay, the notary or public officer who authenticated or signed a transfer, mortgage-constitution or other real-property-right act sends the territorially competent registrar the list of those acts. Include the parties’ names and given names or business names; act number and object; total transaction price stipulated in the deed; parcel location; cadastral or parcel number; and title number if any. This is separate from the parties’ transfer-notification deadline below. [Registration art. 23, continuation](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-property-transactions.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
3. **Transfer notification:** communicate a mutation of titled immovable property or another real right over it to the territorially competent registrar within **60 days following signature**. For a sale under communal land certification, the buyer must convert the certificate to a title within **60 working days from signature**, a different unit of time. A built-property transfer application also needs an insurance certificate covering fire. [Registration arts. 24, 32](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf); [January art. 217](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July art. 237](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
4. **Mortgage dossier:** request inscription within **eight days following signature** of its constitutive deed, with an updated expertise report valuing the property on that date under banking law. The report is entered in the mortgage register and signed/sealed by the registrar. An annotation of a mandate to mortgage or a partial mortgage inscription is prohibited. In communes with land services, the guarantee constitution/inscription on certificates or titles requires a non-liability certificate in the names of debtor, grantor and any surety, issued by the commune administrator or competent registrar, as appropriate. After inscription, obtain the certificate for creditor and debtor recording title references, general/special act number, date, secured debt, duration and any renewal date. [Registration arts. 26, 30, 33](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
5. **Electronic-title conversion:** every landowner must obtain the secured electronic title. The January text gives holders **five months counted from 1 January 2026** to apply; this Guide does not invent a procedural last-day convention. The July text requires application **before 31 March 2027**, using the form established by the land-title/national-cadastre directorate and posted on the justice ministry site. Read the actual form and category/location order before completing the file; neither has been recovered for operational use here. Do not treat the later deadline as an express waiver of an earlier failure. [January arts. 142–143](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July arts. 150–151](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
6. **Payment and completion:** principal-law registration entries that attract duties occur only after payment. Contesting the amount does not postpone payment under that clause, without prejudice to restitution. Keep the authority’s assessed breakdown, payment receipt, lodged-deed acknowledgment and updated title/registration certificate. This research has not verified the current payment account/reference, electronic-title form fields, appointment/submission channel, acknowledgment format or actual service turnaround. Do not mark a submission complete from these statutory steps alone. [Registration art. 18](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
7. **If building an urban house:** obtain the prior building authorisation and approved estimate, pay the building tax, then display the authorisation reference and proof of tax payment on the site. The separate permit-insurance clauses make grant of the building permit conditional on an insurance certificate covering damage to the works and decennial and biennial liability **when the value of the work to be built is estimated at BIF 100,000,000**. The exact legislative condition is « lorsque la valeur de l’ouvrage à construire est estimée à cent millions »; it does not say “at least”. Do not invent a >= threshold or conclude that other estimates are exempt. Its broader application, current required insurance evidence and permit implementation remain held. This is distinct from the fire-insurance certificate for a built-property title transfer. Read the applicable implementing order before an actual permit request. [January arts. 139, 215](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July arts. 147, 235](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Penalties and interest
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-property-transactions.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
- Refusal or delay in transmitting the separate weekly notary/public-officer list attracts **BIF 50,000 per untransmitted act plus 1% of duties due per week late**. Apply this art. 23 sanction to that reporting duty, separately from the parties’ art. 24 transfer-notification charge. [Registration art. 23, continuation](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
- For the principal-law transfer notification after its 60-day clock, art. 24 imposes **1% of duties due per week late** on the parties; it states an increase to **5%** where delay is attributable to the transferor, without prejudice to buyer damages. Check attribution, clock and the actual charge; do not calculate a generic daily interest rate. A mortgage inscription beyond its eight-day clock attracts **1% of duties due per month late**, borne by the creditor. [Registration arts. 24, 26](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
- A requested valuation shortfall reaching **one fifth of market value** attracts a fine equal to the evaded duties, without prejudice to other fiscal sanctions. For a transfer/inscription based on an alienation contract, art. 17 makes transferor and purchaser jointly and indivisibly liable for that fine. Concealing total mortgage debt or requesting partial inscription likewise attracts an evaded-proportional-duty fine; the provision also catches a notary/public officer/agent who contributes to concealing the debt or transaction price. [Registration arts. 16–17, 27](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf).
- The July electronic-title clause imposes a fine of **50% of the secured-title amount** on a titleholder missing its application deadline. It is linked to the **before 31 March 2027** obligation; do not apply it to an ordinary timely 2026 application or retrospectively label it the January clause’s penalty. [July art. 151](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
- Failure to display an urban building-authorisation reference costs **BIF 500,000**, without prejudice to tax due. Starting without authorisation attracts **BIF 1,000,000**, in addition to one per thousand of an estimate prepared by an authorised expert at the taxpayer’s expense. The text does not make these alternative offences a single automatically cumulative fine. [January art. 139](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July art. 147](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
- The principal registration law gives a **two-year** period from registration for recovery of evaded duties/fine, and a **two-year** restitution period from when that action arises. Keep these specialised clauses distinct from the general tax-audit periods; unresolved interaction with a particular later procedure or fraud rule needs referral. [Registration art. 21](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2020/08/BOB_No2BIS-2020.pdf). General tax-default rules are in [tax overview](bi-tax-overview.md#penalties-and-interest).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Cross-border points
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-property-transactions.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: The cited property wealth-tax clauses identify the acquirer and property conditions, without a residence-based concession in those clauses. Do not infer a foreign purchaser’s exemption, ownership permission or treaty reduction. Residence, domestic source withholding and treaty-effectiveness evidence belong to [cross-border tax](bi-cross-border-tax.md); the seller’s individual gain belongs to [income tax](bi-income-tax.md). Foreign-ownership eligibility, exchange-control transfer steps, nonresident conveyancing representation and treaty relief on this property transaction remain unresolved. [January art. 138](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [July art. 146](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).

The raw fee is 61 × BIF 50,000 = BIF 3,050,000, capped at **BIF 3,000,000**. This calculation does not assign category C from the address and is not the complete conveyancing bill. If the holder later misses the July clause’s application deadline, its specified 50% fine would be BIF 1,500,000; no fine arises merely from this timely 2026 calculation. [July arts. 150–151](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Deadlines and filing
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-tax-overview.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. Identify legal form, residence, activity, accounting dates, taxpayer class, turnover, payroll, imports and foreign/related transactions. Obtain RC/NIF, registration certificates and prior returns/payments. The legal registration period is in [company formation](bi-company-formation.md); the VAT thresholds and switch dates belong to [VAT](bi-vat-gst.md).
2. Build separate obligation rows for annual income, any quarterly individual turnover return, corporate advances, monthly VAT, monthly employment withholding, other source withholding, annual employer recap and quarterly INSS, only where the actual facts create that obligation. Use each sibling's deadline and form route; do not call INSS monthly merely because payroll is monthly.
3. Use OBR's [current public portal routing](https://www.obr.bi/index.php/teledeclaration-telepaiement): medium/large taxpayers at [Umutangakori](https://umutangakori.obr.gov.bi/login-econtribuableobr), small/micro at [DPMC Umutangakori](https://umutangakori-dpmc.obr.gov.bi/). The [published July 2023 adhesion manual](https://www.obr.bi/images/Guide-utilisateur-adhesion-et-connexion.pdf) asks for NIF, confidential Extranet number, administrator identity and signed representative authority. Choose “Adhérer au portail”, validate NIF/Extranet, complete administrator identification, upload identity and authority, and submit acceptance. OBR sends acknowledgment, then after approval a password-initialisation link. Keep Extranet credentials private; do not put them in a tax computation.
4. Use the published form sections identified in each Guide and reconcile them to books and tax schedules. Preserve the filed declaration, acknowledgment, bank confirmation and quittance with NIF, period, tax and amount. A portal activation acknowledgment is not an income-return filing receipt, and a payment order is not proof the bank executed it.
5. General records remain locally available for ten years from the relevant fiscal year-end; source-withholding records have the specific ten following-year rule in the cross-border Guide. The general statute moves a deadline falling on a nonworking day to the next working day. A declaration extension request under procedure art. 27 must be made in writing at least fifteen days before due date, supported by unavoidable difficulty; an ordinary extension is once for no more than thirty days and does not extend payment automatically. [Arts. 9, 27 and 32](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_RELATIVE_AUX_PROCEDURES_FISCALES_ET_NON_FISCALES_2020.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Penalties and interest
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-tax-overview.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: The general procedure law distinguishes late declaration, late payment, understatement and failure to withhold. Its art. 130 fixed declaration fines are BIF 100,000 for micro/small, BIF 300,000 for medium and BIF 600,000 for large businesses; art. 131 adds 10% of unpaid principal for late payment. Art. 142 applies a penalty equal to tax not withheld or not remitted. Do not add these mechanically to a VAT-specific penalty. Art. 126 sets interest by the annual ministerial rate plus 1.5 percentage points, simple monthly calculation with part of a month counted as a month. The current ministerial reference rate has not been established here. [Procedure arts. 126, 130–142](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_RELATIVE_AUX_PROCEDURES_FISCALES_ET_NON_FISCALES_2020.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Use for companies controlling or dependent on enterprises outside Burundi, including common-control structures. Art. 57 allows incorporation into taxable results of profits indirectly transferred abroad through purchase/sale prices, thin capitalisation or other means. For that article, dependency exists through majority capital, actual decision power or common control. Its dependency condition is waived where the transfer is to a privileged-tax jurisdiction or noncooperative country. Do not replace that article-specific test with an assumed universal shareholding percentage. [IR art. 57](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## The base
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-transfer-pricing.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. Map each foreign counterparty, ownership/voting links, ultimate control, jurisdiction, contracts, transaction nature, amounts and actual performance. Separate genuine third parties and identify the privileged/noncooperative-jurisdiction override. Keep the group chart, contracts, invoices, functional facts, economic evidence and pricing-policy explanation. These are practical supporting records for the statutory duty, not a claim that Burundi mandates a particular OECD master/local-file template. [IR arts. 2 and 57](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
2. Compare booked consideration with evidence for the price that properly belongs in Burundi taxable results. Explain functions, assets, risks and any comparability differences before relying on an independent price. Quantify the identified transfer and bridge the adjustment into accounting-to-tax profit. An invented margin, an unsigned contract or an invoice alone does not establish the correct price. Art. 57 permits OBR to ask for written information, including where documentation is missing or partial. [IR art. 57](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).
3. For debt, document principal throughout the year, adjusted equity, pre-interest taxable profit, payment/accrual status, contractual rate and local-market evidence. Apply the financing restriction independently of a price adjustment; avoid counting the same disallowance twice. Under the July wording the old below-twice-equity exception is not repeated. Do not carry it forward automatically or deduct unpaid interest. The annual computation where financing straddles the budget cutover needs a settled application basis, rather than an invented half-year prorating rule. [IR art. 56](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf); [Art. 157](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
4. Reconcile the adjusted result and interest disallowance into the annual income return. Source withholding, VAT and a business expense's genuine purpose/evidence are separate tests; a supported transfer price does not waive those obligations. [IR arts. 54, 57 and 104](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_14_DU_24_DECEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_24_JANVIER_2013_RELATIVE_AUX_IMPOTS_SUR_LES_REVENUS_1.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Two worked examples that recompute
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-transfer-pricing.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Assume a Burundi company books a foreign-controlled service charge of BIF 12,000,000. After the actual service and comparability review, evidence establishes BIF 9,000,000 as the amount properly attributable to the services. Other taxable profit before this adjustment is BIF 20,000,000. Add back BIF 3,000,000 and compute the ordinary corporate component BIF 6,900,000 before the separate turnover-minimum/credit tests. The independent amount is a case assumption, not a statutory safe harbor.
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-transfer-pricing.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

```oa-check
name: Documented price difference
inputs:
  booked_charge: 12000000
  supported_charge: 9000000
  profit_before_adjustment: 20000000
steps:
  - adjustment: booked_charge-supported_charge
  - adjusted_profit: profit_before_adjustment+adjustment
  - ordinary_component: adjusted_profit*0.30
expected:
  adjustment: 3000000
  adjusted_profit: 23000000
  ordinary_component: 6900000
```

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Assume the financing is governed entirely by the July rule, pre-interest taxable profit BIF 20,000,000, market-compliant paid related interest BIF 8,000,000 and unpaid accrued related interest BIF 1,000,000. The 30% ceiling permits BIF 6,000,000; total disallowance is BIF 3,000,000. If the extra BIF 1,000,000 were paid, the same ceiling still permits only BIF 6,000,000, so payment alone would not create more deduction. No debt/equity exception is assumed under this wording.

1. Classify each supply before applying a rate. VAT art. 10 exempts specified healthcare, medicines and education subject to its conditions and implementing rules. There is no blanket intermediate rate for all medicine, educational items or essential food. The actual 2021 order annexes identify the qualifying intermediate-rate food/products. Later budget exemptions override where applicable: for example July arts. 210 and 220–223 cover specified seeds, electric/hybrid items and eligible energy/cooking products under their own conditions. Do not price those sectors using only the headline table. [VAT arts. 10 and 19](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_10_DU_16_NOVEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_12_DU_29_JUILLET_2013_PORTANT_REVISION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_17_FEVRIER_2009_PORTANT_INSTITUTION_DE_LA_TAXE_SUR_LA_VALEUR_AJOUTEE_TVA_.pdf); [order arts. 9–22 and annexes](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/BOB_No5-2021.pdf); [budget arts. 210, 220–223](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
2. Determine the tax point: ordinary goods on delivery, services generally on receipt including installments; supplies to the State use receipt of price. Approved invoice-basis exceptions and related-party arrangements require their statutory conditions. Compute consideration excluding VAT with relevant incidental charges; import VAT includes the customs base and border charges as set by the law. [VAT arts. 11–18](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_10_DU_16_NOVEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_12_DU_29_JUILLET_2013_PORTANT_REVISION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_17_FEVRIER_2009_PORTANT_INSTITUTION_DE_LA_TAXE_SUR_LA_VALEUR_AJOUTEE_TVA_.pdf); [Art. 96](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 98](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
3. Deduct only VAT attributable to eligible taxable activity. Keep compliant invoices, customs documents and proof of imported-services VAT. Exclude private/exempt use and art. 21 blocked expenses. Both 2026 budget periods condition deduction/refund on checking payment of collected VAT, cooperation with that check, and an electronic invoice transmitted to EBMS when issued. July adds the traceable-payment condition above. [VAT arts. 20–23](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_10_DU_16_NOVEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_12_DU_29_JUILLET_2013_PORTANT_REVISION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_17_FEVRIER_2009_PORTANT_INSTITUTION_DE_LA_TAXE_SUR_LA_VALEUR_AJOUTEE_TVA_.pdf); [Art. 97](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 99](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
4. Track credits by month and age. Both budgets replace art. 24: after three consecutive credit periods, apply for refund during the following month, subject to the ministerial minimum; a credit not requested then is no longer accepted as a later carryforward, while the art. 33 refund right remains. The 2021 order art. 26 sets an ordinary BIF 15,000,000 minimum, with special categories in art. 27. Its older timing conflicts with the later budgets: use the budget timing and do not present indefinite automatic carryforward. A below-minimum credit follows the express carry exception; special categories need separate examination. [Art. 98](https://www.obr.bi/images/PDF/Loi%20de%20Finances%202025-2026%20Modifi%C3%A9e.pdf); [Art. 101](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf); [arts. 26–28](https://amategeko.gov.bi/wp-content/uploads/2021/07/BOB_No5-2021.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Deadlines and filing
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-vat-gst.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text:
1. Monitor taxable turnover and the independent purchase/import/stock triggers. Under arts. 38–39 apply for registration by the fifteenth day of the following month; statutory invoicing begins from the first day of the month following attainment of the threshold. Retain the VAT certificate and registration date. July's lower threshold changes who is within the test; how OBR treats already accumulated first-half turnover at the July cutover must be resolved for an affected case rather than invented. [VAT arts. 37–42](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_10_DU_16_NOVEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_12_DU_29_JUILLET_2013_PORTANT_REVISION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_17_FEVRIER_2009_PORTANT_INSTITUTION_DE_LA_TAXE_SUR_LA_VALEUR_AJOUTEE_TVA_.pdf); [Art. 271](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).
2. Reconcile EBMS sales, invoices, customs records, imported services, credit history and eligible input VAT. Use [monthly joint return section I](https://www.obr.bi/images/DECLARATION_TVA-_IRE-_PF_ET_AUTRES_RETENUES_A_LA_SOURCE-2021-VF-juillet-2022-vf-1.pdf): sales by rate on lines 1–4; self-supplies 6–7; foreign-services/other VAT 8; output total 9; eligible inputs 10–15 and total 16; net/credit 17–18; prior credit 19; refund request 20; carry 21; tax payable 22. Do not carry an expired budget-restricted credit merely because line 21 exists. Reconcile supplier NIF, invoice date, EBMS transmission and payment trace.
3. Declare and pay within the first fifteen days of the following month, including a nil or credit period where a return is required. OBR publishes separate [Umutangakori links by taxpayer category](https://www.obr.bi/index.php/teledeclaration-telepaiement). Keep the return acknowledgment, EBMS reconciliations and quittance/bank evidence. A refund requires its own request and evidence, not merely deducting an amount at will. Current authenticated submission and refund-screen fields remain unconfirmed. [VAT arts. 25–33 and 52–54](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_10_DU_16_NOVEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_12_DU_29_JUILLET_2013_PORTANT_REVISION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_17_FEVRIER_2009_PORTANT_INSTITUTION_DE_LA_TAXE_SUR_LA_VALEUR_AJOUTEE_TVA_.pdf).
4. Keep VAT books and supporting documents for ten years. If an error is found before audit notification, apply the correction rules and check affected later credits; from July the general procedure allows one correction per declaration before an audit notice. [VAT arts. 51–53](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_10_DU_16_NOVEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_12_DU_29_JUILLET_2013_PORTANT_REVISION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_17_FEVRIER_2009_PORTANT_INSTITUTION_DE_LA_TAXE_SUR_LA_VALEUR_AJOUTEE_TVA_.pdf); [Art. 259](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_DE_FINANCES_2026-2027_PROMULGUEE_compressed.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: ## Cross-border points
all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-vat-gst.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Where a nonresident without a fiscal representative supplies taxable services, the Burundi customer, taxable or not, withholds VAT regardless of the amount under art. 54. Put the output amount on section I line 8; claim an input credit only if the separate recovery conditions are met. A nonresident carrying taxable supplies outside that mechanism must examine the approved fiscal-representative rules in arts. 45–46. International-service zero rating requires its own conditions; a foreign invoice address alone is insufficient. [VAT arts. 19, 45–46 and 54](https://www.obr.bi/images/LOI_N1_10_DU_16_NOVEMBRE_2020_PORTANT_MODIFICATION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_12_DU_29_JUILLET_2013_PORTANT_REVISION_DE_LA_LOI_N1_02_DU_17_FEVRIER_2009_PORTANT_INSTITUTION_DE_LA_TAXE_SUR_LA_VALEUR_AJOUTEE_TVA_.pdf).

all_current_old_guide_body_units.destination: skills/burundi/bi-vat-gst.md (same text; H1 version only if applicable)

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Assume an already registered trader with BIF 10,000,000 taxable sales excluding VAT and BIF 4,000,000 eligible local purchases excluding VAT, all at the ordinary rate, no prior credit and all EBMS, verification and bank-trace requirements satisfied. Output BIF 1,800,000 less input BIF 720,000 gives BIF 1,080,000 due.

```oa-check
name: Ordinary monthly VAT
inputs:
  sales: 10000000
  eligible_purchases: 4000000
steps:
  - output: sales*0.18
  - input: eligible_purchases*0.18
  - due: output-input
expected:
  output: 1800000
  input: 720000
  due: 1080000
```

all_current_old_guide_body_units.old_text: Assume an unregistered trader reaches BIF 30,000,000 taxable accounting-year turnover in July 2026, with no independent purchase or stock trigger before then. Under the first-half turnover rule there would be BIF 70,000,000 headroom to BIF 100,000,000, but under July law turnover is BIF 5,000,000 above the new compulsory threshold. Registration is compulsory; this is not a voluntary-registration choice. Assume August standard-rated sales BIF 5,000,000 excluding VAT, giving BIF 900,000 output tax before input credits.
